```{r ,echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, cache=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=10,fig.width=8, out.width="100%"}

library(ggplot2)

panel_trait_swapped = readRDS("../Data/Working_files/main_trait_plot_mantel.rds")
panel_pheno_swapped = readRDS("../Data/Working_files/main_pheno_plot_mantel.rds")
panel_abundance_swapped = readRDS("../Data/Working_files/main_abundance_plot_mantel.rds")


library(patchwork)

final_plot <- panel_abundance_swapped /
  panel_trait_swapped /
  panel_pheno_swapped +
  
  plot_layout(
    ncol = 1,
    guides = "collect"
  ) &
  
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    
    # ---- increase global text sizes ----
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11)
  )

final_plot

```
